SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.1, Special Branch
REPORT
File No. Municipal Police
S. P. REGS.
Date January 20, 1938.

Subject Rear-Admiral D. Ohkochi, Commander of the Japanese Naval
Landing Party - Inspection of detachments stationed
in the Western District

Made by D.S. Henchman Forwarded by C. Crawford S.I.

Rear-Admiral D. Ohkochi, Commander of the Japanese
Naval Landing Party, during the morning of January 20,
carried out inspection of the detachments stationed at
Nos.3 and 4 Mills of the Naigai Wata Kaisha, 14 West
Soochow Road, and at the staff quarters of the Japan-China
Cotton Mill, 250 Penang Road.

The Admiral in company with his staff officers,
at 9.40 a.m., entered the Settlement from Chapei by way
of Ichang Road Bridge, and his inspection completed, he
left the staff quarters of the Japan-China Cotton Mill
at 10.30 a.m. and returned to his headquarters, Kiangwan
Road, by way of Penang, Gordon, Bubbling Well, Nanking,
Szechuen and North Szechuen Roads.

A police escort which included D.S. Henchman,
D.S. Kamashita and C.D.S. No.24 of the Special Branch,
accompanied the Admiral through the Settlement as far
as Szechuen Road Bridge.

No untoward incident occurred.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH 20 JAN 1938 mB）

D.C. (Special Branch).

日期 1938年1月20日。

事由 日本海军陆战队指挥官大角少将（Rear-Admiral D. Ohkochi）——视察驻扎在西区的小分队

由 D.S. Henchman 制作 经 C. Crawford S.I. 转呈

日本海军陆战队指挥官大角少将（Rear-Admiral D. Ohkochi）于1月20日上午，视察了驻扎在西苏州路14号内外棉株式会社（Naigai Wata Kaisha）第三和第四工厂，以及彭南路250号日华纱厂职员宿舍的小分队。

上午9时40分，大角少将在其参谋军官的陪同下，经由宜昌路桥从闸北进入租界，视察结束后，他于上午10时30分离开日华纱厂职员宿舍，经由彭南路、戈登路、静安寺路、南京路、四川路及北四川路返回其位于江湾路的总部。

一支包括特别处的 D.S. Henchman、D.S. Kamashita 和第24号中国籍侦探巡长（C.D.S. No.24）在内的警察护卫队，陪同大角少将穿过租界直至四川路桥。

未发生任何意外事件。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处特别处 1938年1月20日 mB）

副总监（特别处）。

（批：抄送）
（批：D.R. 20/1）
（签名：Henchman D. S.）
（批：归档 D.B. 21/1）

Subject (in full) Rear-Admiral D. Ohkochi, Commander of the Japanese Naval
Landing Party - inspection of Detachments stationed in Western District.

Made by. D.S. Kamashita          Forwarded by....................

!

Information has been obtained from the Japanese Naval
Landing Party, Kiangwan Road, to the effect that Rear-Admiral
Ohkochi, Commander of the Naval Landing Party, will inspect
the detachments stationed in No. 3 and 4 Mills of the N.W.K.
and the staff quarters of the Japan China Cotton Mill, during
the morning of January 20.

After travelling through Chapei, the Admiral will
enter the Settlement at about 9 a.m. crossing the Ichang
Road Bridge and will proceed direct to No. 3 and 4 Mills of
the N.W.K., 14 West Soochow Road.

At about 10 a.m. the Admiral will leave the mill and
proceed to the staff quarters of the Japan-China Cotton Mill,
No. 250 Penang Road, via Ichang, Ferry and Robison Roads.

After inspecting the detachments stationed in the staff
quarters, the Admiral will leave for the Naval Landing Party
Headquarters at about 10.20 a.m. travelling by way of Penang,
Gordon, Bubbling Well, Nanking and Szechuen Road.
